card.line: Berea was a city in Macedonia where Paul and Silas went after leaving Thessalonica, and where people eagerly checked the Scriptures to see if the teaching was true.

moments.title: Paul and Silas arrive
moments.text: The brothers sent Paul and Silas away at night to Berea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

moments.title: Fair-minded Bereans
moments.text: The Bereans received the message with great eagerness and studied the Scriptures every day to see if these teachings were true. Many of them believed, and so did quite a few important Greek women and men.

moments.title: Trouble follows Paul
moments.text: Jews from Thessalonica heard that Paul was telling God's word in Berea, so they came to stir up the crowds. The brothers sent Paul to the coast right away, while Silas and Timothy stayed in Berea.
